assumption: EdNet has no cheating labels. Flag rate is interpreted as realized FPR under the assumption that cheating is negligible in an ungraded self-study tutor (EdNet/Santa). This assumption is not verifiable from the data.
peer_feature_note: iforest and quantile_rules include peer features (synchrony/agreement within 5 s). EdNet learners do not sit a common timed quiz, so these features are not meaningful on EdNet; their rows are reported but flagged. quantile_rules_no_peers is a harness-constructed detector (frozen train.quantile_scores on BASE_FEATURES), not part of the frozen pipeline.
legacy_threshold_note: LEGACY thresholds use LEGACY validation labels (as deployed); SIM-honest and EdNet thresholds use all-zero validation labels.
